title: chamaecrista ciliolata var. caprina
intro: Chamaecrista ciliolata var. caprina, commonly known as Cow Itch or Goat's Thorn, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and the plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic effects. The therapeutic actions of Chamaecrista ciliolata var. caprina include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
